description: Agent -> server frames the contract must ACCEPT, and the normalised value it must produce. The normalised form is what the server stores and the browser renders, so a Go port that fills a field differently is not 'slightly off' - it changes what an operator reads on the card.

cases.why: The smallest legal heartbeat: a host that can only read its clock still produces a full object - resource all-null (measurement failed) and four empty arrays, never zeros.

0 and null are different measurements in the same frame: an idle CPU reads 0, an unavailable one reads null, and a usage window with no reading keeps both polarities null rather than drawing an empty gauge.

Forward compatibility in the server's direction: a newer agent reporting a field this server has never heard of is accepted and the field is dropped - at the envelope, in the payload and inside a nested object alike - so an upgraded fleet never needs the server upgraded first.

Every agent built before remote update omits the field, and the default has to read 'no': canRestart false, restartMode none - offering the button to a host that cannot restart itself leaves it dead after the swap.
A repo the agent has only just found: limit falls back to 300 commits, head is an object of nulls, and uncommitted stays null - 'not measured yet', which is not the same as 'clean'.

The same distinction inside one frame: a repo whose status could not be read carries uncommitted null, a repo that was read and is clean carries all-zero counters. Collapsing null into zero reports every broken checkout as clean.
porcelain letters default to a SPACE, not an empty string: ' M' means 'unstaged modification', and the space carries that meaning in the index column.

The hazard the case above exists to expose: Go's zero string passes max(1) and is stored AS an empty string, so the same file arrives with x '' instead of ' ' and no error is raised anywhere. Omit the field; do not send "".

The first frame of a remote update: only the command id, the phase and what is running right now are required - progress, target, code and the pane counts default so a phase can be reported before any of them is known.
